## What this assignment will cover

- Reason about the properties of a good hash algorithm.
- Identify the time complexity of hash table operations.
- Reason about the time-space trade-off in a hash table.
- Identify the time complexity of Insertion Sort and Selection Sort in best and worst cases.
- Compare Insertion Sort and Selection Sort and justify which is preferable for a given input.

## Course skills

Primary practice for skills **C7, G3**. See
